en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a large crowd seated in a stadium. The crowd is dressed in early 20th-century attire, with many men wearing hats. In the foreground, a group of distinguished individuals appears to be distributing awards or prizes. Printed text in Greek and French describes the event. The atmosphere suggests an official ceremony, likely athletic or celebratory, held in an ancient or historical stadium.
